fusions.name: Scooped Spray
fusions.desc: Scoops up the ground with both hands and sprays a cone of dirt, dealing 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spade-Hand Chop
fusions.desc: Drives a flattened hand down into the target edge-first, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heaped Earthwork
fusions.desc: Digs and heaps a bank of earth 5 tiles long ahead of you that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
